name: Smooth scouring-rush
desc: Smooth scouring-rush (Equisetum laevigatum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Equisetum laevigatum is a species of horsetail in the family Equisetaceae. It is known by the common names smooth horsetail and smooth scouring rush.
